mapper.select: SELECT o.da_order AS daOrder, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id_user) AS pureUserCount FROM tb_order o GROUP BY o.da_order ORDER BY o.da_order DESC

SELECT u.id_user AS idUser, COUNT(o.id_order) AS totalOrders, o.nm_delivery_address AS nmDeliveryAddress, SUM(o.qt_order_amount) AS totalAmount, o.da_order AS daOrder FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_user u ON o.id_user = u.id_user GROUP BY u.id_user, o.nm_delivery_address, o.da_order ORDER BY daOrder DESC, idUser ASC
